output_voltage.rationale: explicit EMES reference design setpoint within the manufacturer-supported 0-60 V Vset range; not a fixed manufacturer output rating

efficiency.rationale: explicit conservative EMES analysis assumption used only because the current power evaluator requires one efficiency scalar; not a manufacturer-guaranteed efficiency at 25-42 Vin / 36 Vout / 500 W

notes: The datasheet states that output current is input-voltage dependent; 40 A is therefore retained as the family recommended-range ceiling and must not be reinterpreted as a fixed power rating at every Vin/Vout point.

The datasheet states that for Vin much less than 28 V and/or Vout much greater than 28 V the input capacitance/stability design should be reviewed with SynQor applications guidance. The 25 V pack minimum / 36 V setpoint enters that caution region; EMES does not automatically approve the input filter or loop stability.
Electrical-characteristic tables are referenced to 25 degC baseplate, 300 LFM and 28 Vin unless otherwise noted; detailed thermal derating remains outside this slice.

The 90% efficiency value is an EMES modeling assumption kept separate from manufacturer facts. Published example efficiencies must not be silently promoted to a guarantee at the reference operating point.
Raw manufacturer PDF bytes are not pinned in this snapshot; no digest is fabricated.
